config.program: v20 B3 - registered engineering measurement: contract-gated routing on the sealed corpus (12 Aug 2026)

registration_notes.N89.1: Engineering MEASUREMENT milestone, not a claim audit. It measures the B1/B2 library behaviour on the sealed corpus; it cannot promote or withdraw any sealed research claim.
registration_notes.N89.2: Hypothesis registered before measurement: contract-gated routing rejects out-of-contract inputs with ZERO learned forward passes (100% rejection, guard FLOPs only), while in-contract inputs reach the learned path with accuracy equal to the sealed value within t1 = 0.002.
registration_notes.N89.3: Sealed reference for the learned path: M126 cell atoms=8192 (width 32768), sealed accuracy 0.2228 (logs/results/v16/m126_atoms_extension). The ridge re-fit must reproduce it within t1 before the router result is read (known-value reproduction - programme rule).
registration_notes.N89.4: In-contract set: the sealed M126 test codes (v16/m126/f8192_test.npy, float32, (N, 32768), finite). Out-of-contract probes are constructed from the SAME codes by corruption (NaN, inf, wrong width, out-of-range); the contract guard is the arbiter, and every probe's guard verdict is recorded so the probe set is verifiably outside the in-contract set.
registration_notes.N89.5: Displacing neighbours (from M129): reject-option / selective classification (D5), energy-aware routing (D6), retrieval/rule-based tool selection (D1/D4). This milestone measures the same quantities the field measures (rejection, cost, accuracy preservation) on the sealed corpus; no novelty claim is made or licensed.
registration_notes.N89.6: The router is rule-based (no LLM at inference - M127/M129 constraint). The learned path is the standard ridge fallback, used only when no programmatic primitive accepts the input.
registration_notes.N89.7: Cost accounting: rejected inputs pay the guard FLOPs (a comparison over the code) and NOTHING else; learned-path inputs pay the ridge scoring MACs. Reported separately, never conflated. Footprint reported as parameter/MAC counts, not wall-clock.
registration_notes.N89.8: Smoke runs use _smoke_note + _smoke_skip_gates and MUST refuse the sealed output dir. The sealed run is launched with the full gates and writes to logs/results/v16/m130_contract_gate.
registration_notes.N89.9: This evidence is a dated snapshot (not replayable as a corpus artifact); it records exact code paths, seeds, and config so a reader can repeat the run.
